description: Complete redesign of the Operations Console (apps/operations-console) with @counter/ui components, Auth0 integration, dark/light mode, collapsible sidebar, command palette, toast notifications.
findings: Build successful. All 110 existing tests pass. Auth0 route handler, collapsible sidebar with health indicator, command palette, all pages redesigned with @counter/ui. The middleware was updated to exclude /api/auth routes from session checks. tsconfig paths alias added for @/ imports.
